transport_fallback.scope: Transport fallback only. The Zenodo record explicitly states that the Seychelles empirical restoration data were collated from the public Kaiser-Bunbury et al. 2017 IWDB page. Any extracted object must be checked against the primary IWDB study scale/identities before admission.

claim_boundary: The 64 monthly networks are repeated site-by-month observations from one Mahé restoration experiment, not 64 independent island systems. Restoration treatment is experimentally assigned at the site level (4 restored, 4 unrestored), while months are repeated observations within sites. A secondary repository may solve byte transport but cannot replace the primary IWDB source definition or relax identity checks. Network structure/visitation must not be equated with direct plant reproductive dependency without matched reproductive outcomes.
